subject: Halloway Labs — estimate and quick recap

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Halloway Labs — estimate and quick recap

Hi Samir — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for taking the time. Attached is the estimate PDF we discussed; below is a 3-line recap and a proposed next step.

Recap
- Primary use case: near-real-time summarization for customer support (short sequences, bursty traffic)
- Suggested model profile: redwood-medium-quantized (balanced latency/cost)
- Monthly baseline: 2M generation tokens + 5M embedding tokens (see attached)

What I’m sending
- Redwood_Estimate_Hallow_20261116.pdf (attached): line-item pricing, expected SLOs, and recommended Dedicated vs. Hosted split

Next step
- If helpful I can walk through the estimate and the cost breakdown in a quick 25–30 minute screen-share next week. Proposed slots: Tue 11/17 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 11/18 14:00–14:30 PT, or Thu 11/19 09:00–09:30 PT. Or share a time that works for you: https://calendly.com/tessa-morgan/30min

If this landed in procurement hands, I’ve CC’d Monica from our CS team for any ops/security questions.

[Attached: Redwood_Estimate_Halloway_20261116.pdf (PDF, 132KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to hearing if this is the direction you want to go.

Best,
Tessa Morgan

2) We’d prefer a 30-minute call; next Tue (11/30) morning PT works for our team. Procurement is looped in on cost questions.

If you can drop the small table as CSV and confirm the 11/30 09:30–10:00 PT slot I’ll send a calendar invite.
